answer: The quartz register is checked at draw time, fable lists the eligible set, and knoll seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 57 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker forfeits for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 57 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 37 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
